name: Clifford.certA₁
statement:
theorem certA₁ (x₁ x₂ x₃ x₄ y₁ y₂ y₃ y₄ : R) :
    mD x₁ x₂ x₃ x₄ y₁ y₂ y₃ y₄ * gq0 x₁ x₂ x₃ y₁ y₂ y₃ -

name: Clifford.detT
statement:
theorem detT (x₁ x₂ x₃ y₁ y₂ y₃ : R) :
    det3 (x₁ * y₁) (x₁ ^ 2 * y₁) (x₁ * y₁ ^ 2) (x₂ * y₂) (x₂ ^ 2 * y₂) (x₂ * y₂ ^ 2)
      (x₃ * y₃) (x₃ ^ 2 * y₃) (x₃ * y₃ ^ 2) =
      x₁ * y₁ * x₂ * y₂ * x₃ * y₃ * triP x₁ x₂ x₃ y₁ y₂ y₃

name: Clifford.detU
statement:
theorem detU (x₁ x₂ x₃ x₄ y₁ y₂ y₃ y₄ z : R) :
    det4 (x₁ * y₁) (x₁ ^ 2 * y₁) (x₁ * y₁ ^ 2) (x₁ ^ 2 * (x₁ - z)) (x₂ * y₂) (x₂ ^ 2 * y₂)
      (x₂ * y₂ ^ 2) (x₂ ^ 2 * (x₂ - z)) (x₃ * y₃) (x₃ ^ 2 * y₃) (x₃ * y₃ ^ 2) (x₃ ^ 2 * (x₃ - z))
      (x₄ * y₄) (x₄ ^ 2 * y₄) (x₄ * y₄ ^ 2) (x₄ ^ 2 * (x₄ - z)) =
      -(x₁ * x₂ * x₃ * x₄) * (mN x₁ x₂ x₃ x₄ y₁ y₂ y₃ y₄ - z * mD x₁ x₂ x₃ x₄ y₁ y₂ y₃ y₄)

name: Clifford.detV
statement:
theorem detV (x₁ x₂ x₃ x₄ y₁ y₂ y₃ y₄ Z : R) :
    det4 (x₁ * y₁) (x₁ ^ 2 * y₁) (x₁ * y₁ ^ 2) (y₁ ^ 2 * (y₁ - Z)) (x₂ * y₂) (x₂ ^ 2 * y₂)
      (x₂ * y₂ ^ 2) (y₂ ^ 2 * (y₂ - Z)) (x₃ * y₃) (x₃ ^ 2 * y₃) (x₃ * y₃ ^ 2) (y₃ ^ 2 * (y₃ - Z))
      (x₄ * y₄) (x₄ ^ 2 * y₄) (x₄ * y₄ ^ 2) (y₄ ^ 2 * (y₄ - Z)) =
      y₁ * y₂ * y₃ * y₄ * (mN y₁ y₂ y₃ y₄ x₁ x₂ x₃ x₄ - Z * mD y₁ y₂ y₃ y₄ x₁ x₂ x₃ x₄)

name: Clifford.gq_P12
statement:
theorem gq_P12 (x₁ x₂ x₃ y₁ y₂ y₃ : R) :

      gq2 x₁ x₂ x₃ y₁ y₂ y₃ * ((x₁ * y₂ - y₁ * x₂) * (y₁ - y₂)) + cycP x₁ x₂ x₃ y₁ y₂ y₃ * ((y₁ * x₂ - x₁ * y₂) * (x₁ * y₂ - y₁ * x₂)) = 0

name: Clifford.kK_dj

name: Clifford.resD_id
statement:
theorem resD_id (x₁ x₂ x₃ x₄ y₁ y₂ y₃ y₄ : R) :
    let a := det4 y₁ (y₁ ^ 2) (y₁ * x₁) x₁ y₂ (y₂ ^ 2) (y₂ * x₂) x₂ y₃ (y₃ ^ 2) (y₃ * x₃) x₃ 0 0 y₄ 1
    let b := det4 y₁ (y₁ ^ 2) (y₁ * x₁) x₁ y₂ (y₂ ^ 2) (y₂ * x₂) x₂ y₃ (y₃ ^ 2) (y₃ * x₃) x₃ y₄ (y₄ ^ 2) 0 0
    let e₂ := det4 x₁ (x₁ ^ 2) (x₁ * y₁) y₁ x₂ (x₂ ^ 2) (x₂ * y₂) y₂ x₃ (x₃ ^ 2) (x₃ * y₃) y₃ 0 1 0 0
    let e₁ := det4 x₁ (x₁ ^ 2) (x₁ * y₁) y₁ x₂ (x₂ ^ 2) (x₂ * y₂) y₂ x₃ (x₃ ^ 2) (x₃ * y₃) y₃ 1 0 y₄ 0
    a ^ 2 * mD y₁ y₂ y₃ y₄ x₁ x₂ x₃ x₄ - mD x₁ x₂ x₃ x₄ y₁ y₂ y₃ y₄ * (e₂ * (a * x₄ - b) + e₁ * a) =
      y₄ * (y₁ - y₄) * (y₂ - y₄) * (y₃ - y₄) * crs x₁ x₂ y₁ y₂ * crs x₁ x₃ y₁ y₃ *
        crs x₂ x₃ y₂ y₃ * triP x₁ x₂ x₃ y₁ y₂ y₃ * cycP x₁ x₂ x₃ y₁ y₂ y₃

name: Clifford.not_chain_of_extends
statement:
theorem not_chain_of_extends : ∀ (m : ℕ) (c : Fin (m + 6) → ℂ),
    (∀ k : Fin 6, c (Fin.castLE (by omega) k) = Counter6.cx k) → ∀ X, ¬ Chain (m + 6) c X
  | 0, c, hc, X => by
    have : c = Counter6.cx := funext fun k => hc k
    subst this; exact Counter6.not_chain6
  | m + 1, c, hc, X => by
    intro h
    have hc' : ∀ k : Fin 6, (c ∘ (Fin.last (m + 6)).succAbove) (Fin.castLE (by omega) k) =
        Counter6.cx k := fun k => by
      rw [Fin.succAbove_last, Function.comp_apply, ← hc k]; rfl
    have h' : Chain (m + 4 + 3) c X := h
    rw [Chain] at h'
    split_ifs at h'
    · obtain ⟨p, hp, -⟩

name: Clifford.l14_not_cliffordChain_six
statement:
theorem l14_not_cliffordChain_six :
    ∃ c : Fin 6 → ℂ,
      (∀ i j, i ≠ j → ¬ Collinear ℝ ({0, c i, c j} : Set ℂ)) ∧
      (∀ i j k, i < j → j < k → ¬ Collinear ℝ ({c i, c j, c k} : Set ℂ)) ∧
      ∀ S : ℂ → ℂ → ℂ,
        (∀ i j, i ≠ j → S (c i) (c j) ∈ Metric.sphere (c i) ‖c i‖ ∧
          S (c i) (c j) ∈ Metric.sphere (c j) ‖c j‖ ∧ S (c i) (c j) ≠ 0) →
        (∀ i j k, i < j → j < k →
          ¬ Collinear ℝ ({S (c i) (c j), S (c i) (c k), S (c j) (c k)} : Set ℂ)) ∧
        ¬ ∃ p : ℂ, ∀ i : Fin 6, ∃ Y : Set ℂ,
          ((∃ o : ℂ, ∃ r : ℝ, Y = Metric.sphere o r) ∨ ∃ a b : ℂ, a ≠ b ∧ Y = line[ℝ, a, b]) ∧
          p ∈ Y ∧ ∀ j : Fin 5, ∃ q ∈ Y, ∀ k : Fin 4,
            Cospherical ({S (c (i.succAbove (j.succAbove (k.succAbove 0))))
                (c (i.succAbove (j.succAbove (k.succAbove 1)))),
              S (c (i.succAbove (j.succAbove (k.succAbove 0))))
                (c (i.succAbove (j.succAbove (k.succAbove 2)))),
              S (c (i.succAbove (j.succAbove (k.succAbove 1))))
                (c (i.succAbove (j.succAbove (k.succAbove 2)))), q} : Set ℂ)
